title: INDIAN OCEAN RHYTHM
lyrics:
[VERSE]
From yard to reef and back again
Salt and steel, crew and friends
Helicopter shadow drops
Bassline heavy — no full stops

[CHORUS]
Indian Ocean rhythm
Underneath our feet
Boat lights flicker
Western heat

Raise it high
Feel the tide
This is how
We ride
